# Metrics glossary

| Term | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| Active seat | A seat with recorded activity inside the inactivity window |
| Inactive seat | A seat with no recorded activity inside the inactivity window (default 30 days) |
| Acceptance rate | Accepted suggestions divided by shown suggestions, as a percentage |
| Wasted spend | Inactive seats multiplied by the monthly seat cost |
| Budget utilisation | Monthly cost divided by monthly budget, as a percentage |
